passages.title: Passage 1 — The Student Radio Broadcast
passages.text: Our school's radio club is preparing a special programme about student inventors. At the moment, the presenters (1) _____ (check) the microphones while their producer (2) _____ (review) the questions on a tablet. They normally (3) _____ (meet) every Wednesday, but today's rehearsal is an extra session. The club president says, “We have already arranged the interview, and we (4) _____ (introduce) our guest on Friday.” During the live broadcast, while the host (5) _____ (ask) questions, listeners will be able to send messages. The producer has just noticed that the opening music is missing. “Don't worry,” says Mina. “I (6) _____ (find) another track for you now.” A student reporter asks, “(7) _____ (you / record) a short video for the school website next week?” The team (8) _____ (not / finish) preparing the studio yet, so the technician is still adjusting the lights. Over the past month, the new members (9) _____ (learn) how to operate the equipment, and they can now work without help. Everyone hopes that the programme (10) _____ (encourage) more students to join the club.

passages.title: Passage 2 — A Surprise at the Nature Centre
passages.text: Last Saturday, our class visited a nature centre near the coast. At half past nine, we (1) _____ (listen) to a guide when a loud alarm interrupted the talk. A strong gust of wind (2) _____ (strike) the entrance door, and several posters fell to the floor. While the guide was checking the windows, two volunteers (3) _____ (carry) the younger visitors into a safe room and reached it within two minutes. The manager arrived at ten o'clock. By that time, the staff (4) _____ (close) every outdoor area. Before the manager arrived, a technician (5) _____ (discover) a loose cable behind the reception desk. As soon as the electricity returned, the guide (6) _____ (continue) the tour indoors. We (7) _____ (not / see) any animals in the garden that afternoon because the path remained closed. At eleven, our teacher (8) _____ (write) notes about the incident while we were drawing pictures. One student later said that the team (9) _____ (work) carefully before the alarm sounded. When we finally left, everyone (10) _____ (feel) relieved that no one had been hurt.

passages.title: Passage 3 — A Change in My Study Routine
passages.text: I am in Secondary Two, and our school timetable has changed this term. On ordinary school days, my brother (1) _____ (leave) home at seven, while I usually (2) _____ (catch) a later bus. These days, I (3) _____ (take) part in a reading project, so I spend more time in the library. At this very moment, our group (4) _____ (prepare) a display about local history. We started the project three weeks ago and (5) _____ (collect) twelve useful articles so far. Since I (6) _____ (join) the group last month, I have become more confident about speaking in public. Recently, our teacher (7) _____ (give) us several helpful suggestions, and we are using them in our final draft. My cousin once studied at this school; she (8) _____ (graduate) in 2022. The list of tasks on our classroom wall (9) _____ (show) what we need to complete each week. At present, I (10) _____ (not / spend) much time playing games because the exhibition is only two weeks away.

passages.title: Passage 4 — An Email about a Volunteer Programme
passages.text: Dear Ms Lee, I am writing to apply for a place in the community volunteer programme. During last year's summer holiday, I (1) _____ (help) at a small neighbourhood library, where I sorted books and welcomed visitors. The supervisor (2) _____ (choose) me to lead a reading session in August. Before the session began, I (3) _____ (prepare) all the materials with another volunteer. Since that experience, I (4) _____ (develop) greater confidence when speaking to groups, and I use this skill at school today. This month, I (5) _____ (attend) a first-aid course which is still running. Our training group (6) _____ (practise) emergency procedures every Thursday. By the end of next month, I (7) _____ (complete) the course and receive my certificate. I have already spoken to my parents, and I (8) _____ (join) the weekend team when the new programme begins in December. If the centre accepts my application, I (9) _____ (work) hard and follow its safety rules. Thank you for considering my application. I (10) _____ (appreciate) your time and consideration.

passages.title: Passage 5 — A Science Team’s Next Challenge
passages.text: Our science club has entered a competition about saving electricity. Normally, our team (1) _____ (test) simple ideas after school, but this week the members (2) _____ (build) a working model in the laboratory. The teacher (3) _____ (notice) a problem yesterday while we were checking the wires. By the time the technician arrived, we (4) _____ (switch) off the power and moved away from the equipment. We began testing the new design on Monday, and so far it (5) _____ (produce) enough electricity to light a small lamp. Since last Tuesday, the older members (6) _____ (work) on the design every afternoon; they are still improving it now. Our teacher is reviewing the schedule. She has already booked the hall, so the club (7) _____ (present) its model there next Friday. By six o'clock on Thursday evening, the group (8) _____ (finish) all five display boards; the printer will then have time to prepare the posters. At the moment, the club secretary (9) _____ (write) invitations. At the award ceremony next month, we hope the judges (10) _____ (recognise) the effort behind our work.
